name: Bzhy – Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce
author: Wayne Wang

sections.description:
Bzhy is a WordPress plugin for enhancing WooCommerce features.
This plugin is under continuous modular development. You can enable one or more
modules as needed to utilize their functionalities.
We have currently developed a discount module for the plugin.This module implements
dynamic price discounts based on the number of items added to the user’s shopping cart.
We will continue to develop new modules to enhance WooCommerce functionality.
continuously.

Screenshorts

  1. Dashboard of the plugin. You can enable or disable any module supported by this plugin on this page.
  2. Add discount rule.
  3. Discount rule list page. You can goto edit,delete rule page or add policy page from this page
  4. Add discount policy page.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Bzhy – Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce.
  3. Install and activate the Plugin Bzhy – Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce.

Manual installation

  1. Upload Bzhy - Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Bzhy - Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce in your wordpress site if it is not activated already.
  3. Activate `Bzhy – Feature Enhancements for WooCommerce through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. For detailed setup instructions, vist the official Documentation page.
sections.faq:
Are multiple discounts possible ? What is the limit for the number of rules ?

Yes. It is possible to create multiple discount and you can setup any number of discount rules in your store.

Is it possible to exclude products on SALE?

Yes. Only products with discount rules set through product categories will have discounted prices; other products will not have discounted prices.
